Around November last year (http://ars-artificia.com/review-poker-ii-mechanical-keyboard/)) I got myself a Poker 2. It was my first mechanical keyboard, and I'm still using it as a daily driver. I got the blue backlight version (ABS keys) from Amazon and couldn't have been happier.

Then I started to realize that I didn't like ABS keys and that I needed O-Rings. The rings were no problem, but as I tried to get my hands on PBT keys I realized I screwed up big time.... My initial thoughts were like Oh look, it even got the big Enter-Key ! This is nice, I prefer it a little! (Pretty sure you already know where this is going)

So, I fought a few months to finally get my hands on some ISO PBT Keys and in the end got the original Poker 2 keys. Was quite happy with it :) My fatal mistake was still staying active an the Mech community and soon I urged for more and different keys. I switched to Dvorak so I wanted blanks. There were lots and lots and not a single set in ISO layout :/ As a broke ass college student I can't simply buy another keyboard just to get some place to stick the keys on. Furthermore I love the Poker 2 - The worst part was : I don't even care about the layout ! I've used so many different layouts at work + I switched to Dvorak. I couldn't care less about it ! The only thing that drew me toward ISO is that I find the big enter visually more appealing T_T

Well... So now I'm stuck with my ISO Poker 2 and crave for new caps day after day. Trying to sell the Poker 2 and maybe get an Poker 3 - this time with the right layout ... But the screw up is still so fatal...

Well, learned something for life. Do your research and even if you think you don't need anything in the future, be prepared that this might change.

TL;DR: nothing important ^^
